shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---NEXT CONFIG---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
for f in /workspace/app/Dashboard.tsx /workspace/app/page.tsx /workspace/app/layout.tsx /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rn "relative URL\|relative url\|absolute URL\|absolute url" --include=*.md . | head -30

cd /workspace && echo "--- route handlers present? ---"; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name "route.ts" -print -o -name "route.js" -print; echo "(none above = no API routes)"; echo "--- proxy/rewrites? ---"; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name "proxy.ts" -print -o -name "middleware.ts" -print; echo "--- git log ---"; git log --oneline -5
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: $?"

(timeout 90 npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 18; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '<h[23]>[^<]*</h[23]>|Views: [0-9]+|Visitors: [0-9]+|No notifications|Theme: [a-z]+' ; echo "--- exit: $? ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | sed 's/<!-- -->//g' | grep -oE 'Views: [0-9]+|Visitors: [0-9]+|No notifications|Theme: [a-z]+|Loading dashboard' ; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; echo done
